purpose: Restate the main meaning or draw a concise conclusion.
keywords: Neither my older brother nor my younger sister is coming. In other words, I will be alone.
The membership fee is one thousand yen and meals cost extra. That means the total is not just one thousand yen.
He is my father’s younger brother, in other words my uncle.
restrictions: The new wording should make the earlier point clearer or shorter.
mistake: For one illustrative member of a group, use 例えば instead.
